subject: ela
intro: Use multimedia and visuals in presentations.

items.prompt:
Images, charts, and sound in a presentation are:
A) multimedia components
B) counterclaims
C) citations

A chart in a presentation mainly helps to:
A) clarify data
B) hide the point
C) waste time

Multimedia in a presentation should:
A) support the message
B) distract from it
C) replace the content

steps: Support, not distract. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Why add a line graph to a talk on rising temperatures?
A) it makes the upward trend easy to see
B) it hides the data
C) it is just decoration
items.answer: A) it makes the upward trend easy to see

steps: Clarifies the trend. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) it makes the upward trend easy to see

items.prompt:
A student covers every slide with flashing animations and loud, unrelated music. The problem is the media:
A) distracts from the message
B) clarifies the message
C) adds useful evidence

An EFFECTIVE visual display is:
A) clear, relevant, and supports the point
B) crowded and off-topic
C) too small to read
items.answer: A) clear, relevant, and supports the point

solution.answer: A) clear, relevant, and supports the point

items.prompt:
Which slide BEST supports a claim that a city's traffic has worsened?
A) a simple bar graph of car counts rising over five years
B) a cluttered slide of unrelated photos
C) a blank slide
items.answer: A) a simple bar graph of car counts rising over five years

steps: Relevant, clear visual. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a simple bar graph of car counts rising over five years

items.prompt:
The MAIN purpose of multimedia in a presentation is to:
A) clarify claims and emphasize the most important points
B) show off software skills
C) fill silence
items.answer: A) clarify claims and emphasize the most important points

solution.answer: A) clarify claims and emphasize the most important points
